business_summary.text: Aditya Vision is a consumer-durables and electronics retailer operating 207 stores across Bihar, Jharkhand, Uttar Pradesh and Chhattisgarh, with Bihar its largest market.

call_points.text: Revenue grew 27% YoY, above the stated 20-25% long-term aspiration.
More than 30 stores planned for FY27; only three opened in Q1.
6 to 10 stores planned in Madhya Pradesh this financial year, starting with Indore, Ujjain and Bhopal.
10 to 12 stores planned in Chhattisgarh this financial year, where three are open.
Bihar was 72% of Q1 revenue, UP 16% and Jharkhand 11%.
EBITDA margin expanded about 89 bps to 10.4% on lower opex from fewer store openings.
Board approved MSKA & Associates LLP, a BDO member firm, as statutory auditor.
Management declined to give state-wise SSSG or UP store-level sales and EBITDA.
Working capital days were not disclosed; management said it does not measure them quarterly.
No store-count guidance for FY27; management says it has historically guided 25 stores and delivered more.
April was robust; May started colder, with a normal summer expected soon.
Gross margin fell 100 bps as cooling products underperformed and mobiles (ASP up 20%) and laptops took a bigger share.
Other expenses rose on UP expansion, brand ambassador onboarding and sales-linked costs such as credit-card commission.
No equity raise planned this financial year; internal accruals plus short-term working-capital borrowings suffice.
Management declined to give state-wise or mature-store margins, citing competition.
The ~12.8-13% implied interest rate includes lease liabilities; bank borrowing rates were not disclosed.
Unsold inventory is not returned to OEMs; manufacturers help liquidate it before new billings.

EBITDA margin to be between 8% and 10% for the year
Gross margin to be between 15% and 16% going ahead

10 to 12 stores in Chhattisgarh this financial year

industry: Consumer Discretionary > Consumer Services > Retailing > Speciality Retail

operating_notes.text: Store network at 31 March 2026: 118 in Bihar across 38 districts, 33 in Jharkhand across 22 of 24 districts, 53 in UP across 30 of 75 districts and 3 in Chhattisgarh.
Mobiles and laptops together are more than 25% of sales; Q4 mobile ASP rose 20% and laptop ASP 8-10%, diluting the basket margin.
Stores typically break even 9-12 months after opening, per management's stated guidance.
Air conditioners contributed about 42% of Q1FY27 sales and grew around 35% YoY; refrigerators were 15% of sales.
ASP rose 20-25% for mobiles and laptops and 5-6% for air conditioners, per management.
Store network was 210 as of June 30, 2026: 120 in Bihar (all 38 districts), 33 in Jharkhand (22 of 24), 54 in UP (30 of 75) and 3 in Chhattisgarh (2 of 33).

timeline.summary: On its 8 May 2026 Q4/FY26 call, Aditya Vision reported FY26 revenue of ₹2,672 Cr (+18%) and PAT of ₹117 Cr (+11%), with 207 stores across 4 states and a guided 8-10% EBITDA margin.
On its 31 July 2026 Q1FY27 call, Aditya Vision reported revenue of ₹1,193 Cr (+27% YoY), EBITDA of ₹124 Cr at a 10.4% margin and PAT of ₹77 Cr (+40%), with SSSG of 18% and 210 stores.
